recentItems.title: Doctor Who Icons Reunited! Waris Hussein & Carole Ann Ford Discuss Show Origins & Missing Episodes
recentItems.description:
Waris Hussein and Carole Ann Ford join us in the studio for this month's episode of The Whoniverse Show to celebrate the very beginnings of #DoctorWho!
 
💙 Legendary director Waris Hussein looks back on directing the first-ever episode in 1963, from his early meetings with Verity Lambert to the challenges of filming in Lime Grove. 
✨ Carole Ann Ford (Susan Foreman) reunites with Waris to share memories of the original TARDIS set, working with William Hartnell, and the "outsider" spirit that created a phenomenon. 
👀 We dive into the secrets of the 1960s production, including the making of 'An Unearthly Child', the atmospheric lost episode 'Marco Polo', and how the iconic TARDIS interior was built from "scraps." 
🔄 Waris and Carole discuss the modern era, reflecting on Peter Capaldi's Doctor, Sasha Dhawan's portrayal of Waris in 'An Adventure in Space and Time', and what William Hartnell would think of the show today. 
🎭 From the Weeping Angels to the eccentricities of the Doctor, the pair discuss the personality traits that make the character timeless and how the show’s mystery remains its greatest strength. 
🎬 Waris designs his dream modern episode - find out which Doctor, companion, and historical setting he would choose for a new adventure in space and time! 
❓ Plus, our guests answer questions from Russell T Davies, Joe Martin, and Mark Gatiss, and react to incredible fan art from the Whoniverse community.

recentItems.title: Colin Baker Talks The Sixth Doctor, Regeneration, Peri and the "Most Chilling" episode of Doctor Who
recentItems.description:
Colin Baker and Nicola Bryant join Christel Dee for this month's episode of The Whoniverse Show to talk all things #DoctorWho past, present and future!

💙 Colin looks back on his time as the Sixth Doctor, from his unexpected casting to the evolution of his Doctor across TV, audio and beyond.
✨ Colin and Nicola revisit the iconic Doctor and Peri partnership, sharing memories from their travels in the TARDIS and reflecting on how their characters' relationship changed over time.
👀 We discuss classic stories including 'Vengeance on Varos', 'The Trial of a Time Lord' and 'The Empty Child', as Colin reveals the Doctor Who moment that still gives him chills to this day.
🔄 Colin opens up about the Sixth Doctor's 'missing' on-screen regeneration, his later Big Finish farewell and the final words he believes perfectly captured his Doctor.
🎭 From Weeping Angels to the Valeyard, the pair discuss their favourite monsters, companions and characters from across Doctor Who history.
🎬 Colin and Nicola face an impossible choice between three classic props from the Sixth Doctor era. Which relic will survive the Time Vortex?
❓ Plus, Colin and Nicola answer your questions, react to incredible fan creations and share some hilarious behind-the-scenes stories from their years in the Whoniverse.

The Whoniverse Show is made for the fans, by the fans! Drop a comment below and let us know what you want to see next! Share your creations by using #DoctorWhoFanArt or email us at thewhoniverseshow@bbc.com
